group_power.tuning: Team ratings shrink toward the division by 2 games, the same per-team prior College Football Index uses. Each division shrinks toward its conference by 0.5 team, not by 1: copying the college prior would over-shrink a four-team division. Each conference shrinks toward zero by 1 division. These group priors are defaults and still need a pregame holdout. They are not added to the neutral win-chance rank or the EPA spread.
